text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. Thank you for your consideration of this matter. These appointments are a result of the following public member's terms coming to an end: - Emma Richardson, term ending June 30, 2024 and until a successor is appointed.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 30, 2026 and until successors are appointed: - Mubarek Baker - Farhan Chaudhary - Dalreen Fobler - Lauren Lee - Claire Lukka
